articleTitle: Keynotes
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Network and Information Systems for Computers (ICNISC)
abstract: Provides an abstract for each of the keynote presentations and may include a brief professional biography of each

articleTitle: Improved Roulette Wheel Selection-Based Genetic Algorithm for TSP
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Network and Information Systems for Computers (ICNISC)
abstract: Genetic algorithms are typical swarm intelligence techniques based on the mechanics of natural selection and natural genetic, which combines artificial survival of the fittest concept with genetic operations abstracted from nature. Since the genetic algorithm has good global search capability, as well as the parallel nature of other advantages, it has been widely used in combinatorial optimization, machine learning, signal processing field, adaptive control and artificial life and so on. It is one of the key technologies related to modern intelligent calculation. Fitness proportionate selection, as a common selection method for GA, is usually implemented with method of roulette wheel selection. In this paper, an improved selection method based on fitness proportionate selection was presented. Computational results show that the method which proposed in this paper improved the result precision and better astringency by solving TSP problem.

articleTitle: LEACH-T: LEACH Clustering Protocol Based on Three Layers
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Network and Information Systems for Computers (ICNISC)
abstract: Power consumption of routing protocols is one of the main issues that wireless sensor networks (WSNs) encounter in their lifetime. Low-Energy Adaptive Clustering Hierarchy (LEACH) clustering protocol was introduced to reduce power consumption. However, in LEACH, power consumption increases massively as the distance between sink node and cluster heads (CHs) increases. This drawback introduces distance as one major issue in LEACH since it does not contain routing. In this work, a LEACH based protocol consists of three layers (LEACH-T) is proposed. Each layer has its own CHs. The layers attempt to reduce the distance between sink node and CHs. The third layer is utilized if the distances between CHs and sink node exceed a threshold value. To measure the performance of LEACH-T, simulation is utilized to compare its consumption to pure LEACH. Results show that the proposed protocol extends network lifetime and reduces power consumption.

articleTitle: Multi-service Routing Algorithm Based on Geo/Leo Satellite Networks
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Network and Information Systems for Computers (ICNISC)
abstract: With regarding to the unbalanced load and the multimedia service of multimedia QoS requirements in GEO/LEO double layer satellite networks, a GEO/LEO double layer satellite networks multi-service routing algorithm is proposed. Based on satellite network topology dynamic discretization, the algorithm defined link initial weights with delay and residual bandwidth and introduced the concept of key link. Combining business utilization to adjust different business link initial weights, so as to allocate network resources reasonable, content a variety of QoS requirements and optimize the satellite network link utilization. The simulation results show that the algorithm not only guarantees the delay requirements of different priority business, but also upgrade the properties of throughput and load balancing relatively, improve the performance of satellite network system as a whole.

articleTitle: Research and Implementation of Video Codec Based on FFmpeg
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Network and Information Systems for Computers (ICNISC)
abstract: In this information age, a efficient video encoding/decoding technology will help reducing information redundancy, delaying processing, enhancing the robustness, improving visual perception of quality, increasing the compression ratio, etc. At first, this article describes the history of video encoding/decoding standards development. Research on the key technologies of H.264 coding standard currently which is most widely used. And this thesis will further analysis on the technical improvement of the new generation of High Efficiency Video Coding (HEVC) standard. At the same time, according to the international standard and theory, using ffmpeg and sdl2.0 function library, in win32 environment, and through MFC package the code, developed a software. Through the software debug, realized the encoding/decoding and playing H264 and HEVC format video in this thesis, meanwhile, it also realized the mutual format conversion between H264 and HEVC format.

articleTitle: Mobile Satellite Network Virtual Mapping Algorithm Based on Node Risk
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Network and Information Systems for Computers (ICNISC)
abstract: On the basis of the existing virtual network mapping algorithm, for the problems of mobile satellite virtual network mapping, such as greater network overhead and so on, proposed a mobile satellite network virtual mapping algorithm based on node risk. The algorithm judge the nodes' risk parameter, considered the threshold number of virtual nodes mapping and satellite nodes acceptance threshold, as far as possible, mapping to lower risk parameter satellite nodes, the simulation shows that compared with VNA algorithms, virtual network request accept rate, the satellite resource utilization, network overhead three have a significant improvement.

articleTitle: Compressed Sensing Remote Sensing Image Reconstruction Based on Wavelet Tree and Nonlocal Total Variation
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Network and Information Systems for Computers (ICNISC)
abstract: Compressed sensing reconstructs data using much less sampling data, generally as O(K+Klogn), compared to Nyquist theory. K is the sparsity of data and n is the length of data. Furthermore, according to the basic principle of structured sparsity theory, for a standard K-sparse data, the measurements need for reconstructing original data can be further reduced from O(K+Klogn) to O(K+logn). The wavelet coefficients have tree structure and can be used in compressed sensing. The nonlocal total variance (NLTV) is highly effective in sharping image edges and preserving fine details. It also performs well in getting rid of the block effects caused by total variance (TV). Consequently, a new model based on NLTV and wavelet tree is proposed in this paper for solving the compressed sensing remote sensing image reconstruction. Experiments show the well performance of our model in reconstruction accuracy compared to other methods.

articleTitle: The Important Node Assessment Method of Satellite Network Based on Near the Center
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Network and Information Systems for Computers (ICNISC)
abstract: The satellite network systems complex and costly, to assess the satellite network survivability is important, to assess the satellite network survivability first to assessment of the importance of satellite network node. The existing methods to assess the accuracy of inaccurate problems and high dynamic characteristics of the satellite network topology, a new evaluation method based near the center of the rapid assessment of the importance of satellite network nodes, case study shows that this method is simple, intuitive, and results of the assessment more reasonable.

Index Terms: Importance Of Nodes In The Network

articleTitle: Cloud Storage Third-Party Data Security Scheme Based on Fully Homomorphic Encryption
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Network and Information Systems for Computers (ICNISC)
abstract: Cloud storage, which is an architecture based on Internet, has a strong demand on data stored in the cloud servers. As the application area of cloud storage expands, problems about its third-party data security become more and more prominent. Based on the analysis of cloud storage services architecture, we propose a third-party data security solution based on fully homomorphic encryption, which is a recent breakthrough in cryptography, and can process the encrypted data through fully homomorphic transformation, thus solves the third-party cloud storage data privacy problems well. If anomaly detection or processing can be done on the encrypted data, it will have great commercial values. Our solution can assist filter to confirm encrypted junk e-mails and make it possible for users to fetch information from the search engines without exposing the content of the request. Both these can't be done by conventional security solutions, so our solution greatly promotes the development of security technologies in the cloud storage.

articleTitle: Fault-Tolerance and Minimum Cost Placement of Bistatic Radar Sensors for Belt Barrier Coverage
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Network and Information Systems for Computers (ICNISC)
abstract: Barrier coverage is an important problem in wireless sensor networks and is used to guarantee the detection of an intruder that tries to cross a protected region. Most of previous studies on barrier coverage are based on the disk coverage model or sector coverage model. Recently, barrier coverage based on the bistatic radar sensor model has received more attention. The coverage area of abistatic radar is different from that of the disk and sector coverage and is dependent on the distance between the transmitter and the receiver. In particular, in [8], Wang et al. studied belt barrier coverage in bistatic radar sensor model and proposed algorithms that minimize the total placement cost spent in constructing the barrier. Note that belt barrier is a line barrier with the breadth not smaller than a predefined threshold so that the coverage quality can be improved. The purpose of this paper is to study belt barrier coverage in bistatic radar sensor model. We first propose a new deployment method that further reduces the total placement cost of [8]. We then study the fault-tolerance issue and the energy-saving issue. To the best of our knowledge, our work is the first paper that studies these two issues in belt barrier coverage in bistatic radar sensor model.

articleTitle: Searchable Encryption with Conjunctive Field Free Keyword Search Scheme
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Network and Information Systems for Computers (ICNISC)
abstract: Prior Searchable Symmetric Encryption (SSE) works focus on single keyword search. Conjunctive Keyword Searches (CKS) schemes enhance system usability by retrieving the matching files. Most of existing conjunctive keyword works that use conjunctive keyword searches with fixed position keyword fields are not useful for many applications, such as the body of e-mail and unstructured text. The recipients have to repeatedly perform the search protocol for many times. In our paper, we propose a new symmetric key encryption scheme which supports a keyword field free method for conjunctive keyword search on encrypted file without needing to specify the positions of the keywords where the keywords can be in any arbitrary order. In this scheme, the recipients can give the server one trapdoor for multi keywords. In other words, the proposed method will retrieve the data in one round of communication between the recipients and server, and the search process could not leak any information about the number of keywords in query. Furthermore, we introduced an efficient secure index construction based on pseudorandom functions and Bloom filters. Through analysis section, we determine how such scheme could be used to guarantee fast, low storage overhead and secure access to the database.

articleTitle: A Simple and Effective Method for Hand Gesture Recognition
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Network and Information Systems for Computers (ICNISC)
abstract: Hand gesture recognition is very important for HCI (human computer interaction). We introduce a simple method to recognize hand gestures. After the hand region is segmented from the background, the distance signature is constructed to describe the shapes of hand gestures. Then, the recognition of hand gestures is accomplished using the KNN classifier. The experimental results on one image collection of hand gestures demonstrate that our method works well for hand gesture recognition. Moreover, our method shows better performance than a state-of-art method on another data set of hand gestures.

articleTitle: Product Related Information Sentiment-Content Analysis Based on Convolutional Neural Networks for the Chinese Micro-Blog
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Network and Information Systems for Computers (ICNISC)
abstract: Sentiment analysis is a hot topic in natural language processing. People usually concern the sentiments in a specific domain. By focusing on specific domain such as micro-blogs of a specific product, we can discover the sentiment distribution of customs about this product. Unlike traditional sentiment analysis which divides the sentiments into positive/negative and neutral categories, we divided the product related information into three types: positive/negative about the product and product advertisements. The reason for this kind division is that ordinary positive category in sentiment analysis may contains product advertisements which do not reflect custom's opinions. This phenomenon is very common in micro-blog where there are lots of product promotions and propagandas. In this paper, we propose a sentiment analysis method based on Convolutional Neural Network (CNN). The proposed CNN model combines Chinese word-level embedding and Chinese character-level embedding as input features of the sentiment analysis. In the experiment, Chinese micro-blog datasets of weight loss products and mobile phones are used to show that our sentiment analysis method has better performance than the lexicon based method.

articleTitle: Design of UAV Avionics Automatic Test System Based on Virtual Instrument
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Network and Information Systems for Computers (ICNISC)
abstract: The latest virtual instrument and automatic test technology are adopted. One set of UAV avionics automatic test system for comprehensively testing radio altimeter, diastimeter anti-collision and alarm system, radio compass and multi-mode receiver is designed based on PXI module and GPIB instrument. Realization concept of key technologies, such as software and hardware design method, interface adaptation, equipment excitation, ICD management and other key technologies are given.

articleTitle: Credit Risk Evaluation Using: Least Squares Support Vector Machine with Mixture of Kernel
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Network and Information Systems for Computers (ICNISC)
abstract: Credit risk evaluation under the background of big data has been the major focus of financial and banking industry due to recent financial crises. Recent studies have revealed that emerging modern optimization techniques are advantageous to statistical models for credit risk evaluation, such as LS-SVM. In this paper, a least squares support vector machine with mixture kernel (LS-SVM-MK) is proposed to solve the problem of the traditional LS-SVM model, such as the loss of sparseness and robustness. Thus that will result in slow testing speed and poor generalization performance. The revision model LS-SVM-MK is equivalent to solve a linear equation set with deficient rank just like the over complete problem in independent component analysis. A minimum of 1-penalty based object function is chosen to get the sparse and robust solution. Some credit card datasets are used to demonstrate the effectiveness of this model. The experimental results show that LS-SVM-MK can obtain a small number of features and improve the generalization ability of LS-SVM.

articleTitle: MRFP: Discovery Frequent Patterns Using MapReduce Frequent Pattern Growth
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Network and Information Systems for Computers (ICNISC)
abstract: In this paper, a novelty of a new method has been presented. MRFP-Growth is implementing to solve the problem of discovering frequent patterns with massive datasets. Most of the frequent patterns algorithms are unable to manipulate with the large datasets, our scheme implement FP-Growth method under MapReduce framework in Hadoop platform to decrease the massive datasets. The efficiency and performance of a new method has been increased compare with other mining algorithms.

articleTitle: Research on the Computer Algorithm Application in Urban Rail Transit Holiday Passenger Flow Prediction
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Network and Information Systems for Computers (ICNISC)
abstract: Along with the large scale construction of urban rail transit and the application of computer science in the transportation industry, the reasonable, accurate urban rail transit passenger flow prediction has important significance for the line construction benefit analysis, transportation scheme evaluation, passengers monitoring, and emergency response and so on. This paper studies the current integrated prediction method and calculation model system, analyzes the National Day holiday passenger flow data characteristic of Guangzhou Metro Line 5, and proposes a passenger flow prediction method combined the time series model and regression model. And then the results through experiment and demonstration shows that the model can obtain the better forecast precision. This algorithm has strong practical significance for urban rail transit passenger flow short-term and abnormal forecast.

articleTitle: A Linux Server Operating System's Performance Comparison Using Lmbench
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Network and Information Systems for Computers (ICNISC)
abstract: Linux Server Operating system is widely used in electric power SCADA systems in China. In order to study the performance difference between different distribution Linux Server operating systems so that we can select an appropriate distribution to use, the paper compares four secure Linux server operating system's performance using lmbench benchmarking methodology. The experiments showed that lmbench could effectively distinguish the performances between different Linux Server operating systems and is extremely useful for our Linux Selection.

articleTitle: Research of Power Grid's Real-Time Data Acquisition and Monitoring
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Network and Information Systems for Computers (ICNISC)
abstract: In this paper, a method of grid real-time data's acquisition and monitoring has been introduced. Take DE1-SOC as a core component, plus a small amount of peripheral device, which can realize the function of system. Furthermore, FPGA is used to complete the electric monitoring of frequency deviation and the sequence of the three-phase power system, ARM9 is applied to monitor the harmonic of power system, by using fast Fourier transform (FFT). To conclude, this system can carry on the monitor to the power grid, found the fault problem timely, efficiently, and ensure power grid operates safely and stable.

articleTitle: Application of Random Forest and Back Propagation Neural Network in Estimating Radiation-Based Reference Evapotranspiration Model in Gansu Province
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Network and Information Systems for Computers (ICNISC)
abstract: Reference evapotranspiration (ETo) is an important factor in the water-saving agriculture and in the soil-plant-atmosphere continuum. Many machine learning methods have been introduced into predicting ETo. In order to improve the accuracy of radiation-based ETo models, this paper presents an ETo model called RFR based on random forest (RF). By taking the results of FAO Penman-Monteith (FAOPM) model as the standard, 4 radiation-based ETo models, including RFR model, Priestley-Taylor (PT) model, Makkink model and BPR model (radiation-based ETo model based on back propagation neural network) were evaluated in Yumen, Gansu Province. Results show that RFR model can fit the nonlinear mapping relationship between the radiation parameters and ETo well. The accuracy of RFR model (with RMSE of 0.81 mm/day) is superior to BPR model (with RMSE of 0.89 mm/day) and other compared empirical models. At the same time, training time of RFR model is shorter than BPR model. Therefore, the method for constructing ETo model based on random forest can effectively improve the accuracy of radiation-based ETo model in Gansu Province.

articleTitle: The Study on Network Information Security
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Network and Information Systems for Computers (ICNISC)
abstract: The connectivity and openness of computer network greatly facilitates the sharing of resources. However, accompanied with the growing popularity and the expansion fields of network usage, unauthorized access, network data theft, hacker attacks, virus attacks and a series of network information security problems become visible. This paper focuses on the need of legislation protecting network information security, the existing regulations as well as the design principles of network information security system, and further explores the precautions on network information security.

articleTitle: Research and Implementation of Security Cipher-Text Clustered Index Based on B+ Tree
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Network and Information Systems for Computers (ICNISC)
abstract: To solve the problem of mass encrypted information efficient safety retrieval, based on the cipher-text retrieval in cloud environment, a kind of safety cipher-text clustered index based on B + tree is builded and a cipher text full text retrieval system is implemented. To ensure the system security and data privacy, retrieval process completely is all under the cipher-text environment. System security analysis showed that can effectively resist cipher-text-only attack and choose plain-text attack. The test performance results show that it not only has high safety, but also has a good retrieval efficiency.

articleTitle: An Extractive Multi-document Summarization Technique Based on Fuzzy Logic Approach
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Network and Information Systems for Computers (ICNISC)
abstract: With the expansion of World Wide Web services due to the growing explosion of information during these recent years automatic summarization has become primordial to provide efficient mechanisms to resume and present effective textual information. This technology can summarize multiple or single documents to get a summary. In this paper we develop method based on Fuzzy ontology extraction technique. We focus this research only in the purpose to introduce a Multi-Document Summarization Technique for Gabonese Documents. And in the purpose to realize a comparative study between our general approach and current techniques we adopt Timestamp as the comparative method. This research approach successfully generates a summary with greater information.

articleTitle: A Hybrid Hierarchical Software-Defined Photonic On-Chip Network
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Network and Information Systems for Computers (ICNISC)
abstract: Photonic network and software-defined network are two promising technologies to improve the performance and scalability of on-chip network. However, both the technologies cannot address the problem alone. In this paper, we propose HaoDo, a hybrid hierarchical software-defined photonic On-Chip Network. The proposed architecture combines the advantages of photonic network and centralized control plane, and improve the scalability of whole network. The main contributions includes: we design HaoDo, a hybrid hierarchical control plane which can reduce the computational complexity growth of the SDN control plane and utilize the advantage of electronic short-distance communication and photonic long-distance communication, the hierarchical communication protocol is presented to guide the intr-/inter-area transmission. The discussions present the reason why the HaoDo network can achieve good performance and the possible design exploration for specific applications.

articleTitle: Research on the Graphic Correction Technology Based on Morphological Dilation and Form Function QR Codes
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Network and Information Systems for Computers (ICNISC)
abstract: As a kind of widely used form of two-dimension codes, the QR codes have been widely applied in various aspects of our life, but in the process of the use of the QR codes, the QR code images captured often suffer from deformity because the QR code label is attached onto the object irregular surface (for example, a curve surface) or the camera and the QR code label are different in position, therefore, the QR code image recognition correction method based on the shape function has been put forward and verified, with the experimental results showing that the improved algorithm can restore the graphic effect.

articleTitle: Game Theory-Based Network Rumor Spreading Model
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Network and Information Systems for Computers (ICNISC)
abstract: With the popularity of the micro networks, network rumors bring huge harm to social stability and people's lives. Network rumors have become one of hotspots currently. Thus, from the standpoint of text recognition and blocking rumor spreading, this paper considers the relation between rumor makers and many disseminators as a game to set up ET Game Model and find a game equilibrium. The ET model takes the explosion set by makers and disseminator's trust degree to information source nodes into account, which affect the game. And it is concluded that the two sides can gain the best benefits under the condition of high explosion and trust degree. This paper finds that transmission rate is not better with a higher explosion degree sometimes. By simulating information transmission in social network, we find the best explosion value for rumor spreading and the impact of trust degree on rumor spreading. These conclusions will be used for network rumors identification.

articleTitle: An Extensible Universal Reverse Proxy Architecture
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Network and Information Systems for Computers (ICNISC)
abstract: With the rapid development of the computer techniques, researchers develop more and more application layer protocols to realize new functions. However, traditional reverse proxy servers can't support these new protocols very well because of low extensibility. To solve the problem, we propose an extensible universal reverse proxy architecture which makes reverse proxy server more adaptive to new protocols by employing corresponding protocol plugins. When a client request comes, the universal reverse proxy server will analyze the data header by the protocol filter and then call the appropriate protocol plugin thread from the plugin pool, which will handle the client request and perform the reverse proxy work. Experimental results show that this architecture has the advantage of universality, extensibility and efficiency.

articleTitle: The Combination Method of Conflict Evidence Based on Classification Correction
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Network and Information Systems for Computers (ICNISC)
abstract: In order to efficiently combine highly conflict evidence, a new method of evidence combination was presented. Firstly, since traditional evidence distance can't measure the degree of similarity between evidence effectively in some cases, the paper analyzed traditional evidence distance functions and combined with Jousselme distance, then presented a new evidence distance. And then, reliability of each evidence was obtained to determine relative reliability and weight factors, according to the new evidence distance. Secondly, evidence was classified into three categories: consistent evidence, non-conflict evidence and conflict evidence, according to the new evidence distance parameter and the local conflict parameter. Finally, different evidence was revised in different ways by using relative reliability and weight factors, then revised evidence was combined by means of Dempster's combination rule. A numerical example shows that the proposed method can combine highly conflict evidence efficiently and accelerates convergence.

articleTitle: An Efficient Total Prefix Length-Based Clustering Packet Classification Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Network and Information Systems for Computers (ICNISC)
abstract: Packet Classification (PC) is a key functionality for next-generation Internet routers to provide various advanced services. In such high-speed network environment, the accuracy and efficiency of packet classification plays an important role in the development of network. Based on analyzing the characteristics of the real rule set, we propose the Efficient Total Prefix Length-Based Clustering Packet Classification Algorithm (TPLBC). The TPLBC has a two stage hierarchical search structure by employing two novel ideas.(1)The TPLBC partitions the rules into different clusters by the similar total source/destination prefix length. Building a priority pruning binary tree in stage 1 according to these clusters. (2)Building the Priority Area-based Quad-Tree in these clusters achieves fine space performance and search speed in stage 2. The experimental results show that compared with traditional PC algorithm, the algorithm supports dynamic update of rule set and achieves high-speed packet classification.

articleTitle: DSTP-End to End Based Approach to Optimize Data Transmission for Satellite Communications
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Network and Information Systems for Computers (ICNISC)
abstract: Since several years, satellite communications are playing a remarkable role in telecommunications infrastructures, thus the increasing interest in transporting internet traffic over satellite links. Many technologies such as the deployment of multicast and real-time audio/video streaming application are likely to increase the percentage in the context of TCP traffic in internet. The Transport Control Protocol assures the internet transport protocol that supports many common applications including e-mail service, ftp, http or telnet. It also provides the reliable delivery of the data from sending to receiving devices. In the transmission/reception process, most of the critical problems are the Long Delay, and the High bit error rate (BER). B. E. R (Bit Error Rate, refers to a value) relative to the error rate measured at the receipt of a transmittal digital, relating to the level of mitigation and /or disruption of a signal transmitted and Latency is a minimum transmission delay in computer communications. It means the time required for a packet of data from the source to the destination through a network because To any package transmitted by network corresponds to a value of latency. In this observation, the implementation of congestion control mechanism should be realized by taking account the need to provide a better solution to prevent senders from flooding the network with data to the point that intermediate routers have no buffers left and have to discard data, which TCP will then have to retransmit. In this paper we analyze an optimized Vegas TCP Congestion Control Algorithm for satellite communication system. Our main contribution here consists to ameliorate the flow control mechanism by modifying the algorithm we implement the protocol DSTP to provide a special rate based scheme. By increasing windows size, we develop the TCP protocol for high speed wide area network.

articleTitle: An Optimal Deployment with Conectivity Information Airborne Wireless Sensor Network
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Network and Information Systems for Computers (ICNISC)
abstract: Airborne wireless sensor network (AWSN) draws the many attention recently. Deployment problem is a fundamental issue in wireless ad hoc and sensor networks. Previous techniques for deployment scheduling need accurate GPS information or range methods. Which resumes lots of enengy and computation of the node. Recently, a method based on topology is proposed to achieve exact deployment using topology information. Our method based on establishing a graph theoretical framework to connect the airborne mobile sensor. Making use of the connectivity information of nodes to some degree, our plan permits adjust the quality of deployment by using some sensing ranges and needs of different application scenarios. We proved the effectiveness of our approach through lots of simulations and some real experiments with several airborne mobile sensor nodes in the room.

articleTitle: Mobile IPV6 Fast Switching Technology Research
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Network and Information Systems for Computers (ICNISC)
abstract: Through the introduction of mobile IP functional entities, the paper elaborated on the operation mechanism of mobile IPV4. According to mobile IP mechanism, the paper analyze the reasons for the formation of mobile IPV4 triangular routing, and describe a method to solve the triangular routing, On the basis of IPV6 concept, the paper analysis the mobile IPV6, then discuss the IPV6 movement of the working mechanism that combined with the operating mechanism of mobile IPV4, and comparative analysis of the differences between mobile IPV4 and mobile IPV6, then elaborated IPV6 gene advantage in terms of solving the triangular routing problem, Through the Micro-mobility protocol analysis, based on IPV6 fast switching technology, the paper proposed a fast switching technology of Micro-mobility protocol introduced in mobile IPV6.

articleTitle: Research on Cloud Network Infrastructure of Sea Battlefield
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Network and Information Systems for Computers (ICNISC)
abstract: Cloud network system will meet the military demand on sea battlefield more effectively. Taking cloud computing as the core, the conception of sea battlefield cloud network has been presented. Combat cloud from it can strengthen the capability of collaborative combat in sea battlefield. Then, infrastructure of sea battlefield cloud network is constructed according to the tactics needs on sea battlefield which composes with core service, service management and user access interface. All resources here will be presented in the form of service. Thus, Services of three levels in sea battlefield cloud network are described. An example of military information processed is presented to explain servers and their relationships. The results of this paper can be used for network constructing in sea battlefield condition to support the future centric warfare.

articleTitle: Code-Based Provable Data Possession Scheme for Integrity Verification in Cloud Storage
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Network and Information Systems for Computers (ICNISC)
abstract: Benefited from cloud storage services, users can save their cost of buying expensive storage servers. Meanwhile they lost the physical control of their data. So effective methods are needed to verify the correctness of the data stored in cloud servers, which are the research issues the provable data possession (PDP) faces. This paper analyzes the existing PDP algorithms, finds some defects of these algorithms, such as highly computing cost, a limited number of challenge. Then proposes code-based provable data possession scheme for integrity verification based on homomorphic code-based hash function, the advantage of homomorphic hash function is providing provable data possession and data integrity protection. The scheme is a good way to ensure the integrity of remote data and to reduce redundant storage space and bandwidth consumption. The major cost of the scheme is in the server side, it is suitable for mobile devices under cloud storage environments. We prove that the scheme is feasible by analyzing the security and performance of the scheme, most of all, the scheme can resist the attack of post-quantum computers.

articleTitle: Research of Character Recognition Based on BP Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Network and Information Systems for Computers (ICNISC)
abstract: Artificial To better achieve character recognition, analyze the impact of noise character. BP neural network application describes the process of character recognition, and the corresponding algorithm improvements. Created with MATLAB and training the neural network to identify the different samples, combined toolbox simulink simulation module, so that the character recognition to get better recognition rate.

articleTitle: Design of Intelligent Mobile Video Surveillance System Based on 4G
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Network and Information Systems for Computers (ICNISC)
abstract: With the development of science and technology and the improvement of living standards, people pay more and more attention to security issues, the mobile video surveillance has become an important way of monitoring based on 4G network construction, the popularity of the new generation mobile intelligent terminal and the development of video coding and decoding technology. This paper mainly introduces the design of mobile video surveillance system based on 4G, first of all, the overall system architecture, the main equipment, RTP/RTCP protocol, H.264, FFMPEG encoding and decoding, 4G wireless networks and other key technologies are introduced in detail, at last, through the experiment, the whole system performance is stable, and the purpose of the design is achieved.

articleTitle: A Threshold-Based Kalman Filter with Recursive Covariance Estimation
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Network and Information Systems for Computers (ICNISC)
abstract: In the existing works, a Kalman filter with recursive covariance estimation (KF-RCE) was proposed by Bo Feng et al. to sequentially estimating process noise covariance matrix. However, there may be a singular matrix existed in the KF-RCE algorithm, which would lead to unreasonable system state estimation in the system initial stage. In this paper, a threshold-based Kalman filter with recursive covariance estimation (TBKF-RCE), which uses a threshold-based switch scheme, is presented to suppress the singularity phenomenon brought by the singularity matrix in KF-RCE algorithm. Simulation results have shown that the singularity phenomenon which happened in the system initial stage has been weakened by using the TBKF-RCE algorithm.

Author Keywords: threshold-based Kalman filter with recursive covariance estimation (TBKF-RCE)
Kalman filter with recursive covariance estimation (KF-RCE)

articleTitle: A Secondary Index for Improving Reading Performance in the Inline Deduplication System
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Network and Information Systems for Computers (ICNISC)
abstract: With the advent of cloud computing, huge amount of data are stored on the cloud. To remove the redundant data, the Deduplication technology is proposed and attracts many interests from both the academic and industry. In the Inline Deduplication System, improving the read performance is very vital. However, existing works is inefficient when massive data are involved. In this paper, we first propose a Secondary Index Assisted Read scheme (SIAR) in the Inline deduplication system. To reduce the frequency of disk access, and improve the read performance, we build a secondary index in the RAM and disks, which makes full use of the high random-read performance properties of RAM and the low cost of disk. Further, we analyze the trade-off between the performance improvement of SIAR and memory overhead, which makes the proposed scheme adaptive to different applications. Finally, we conduct extensive experiments, which confirms the efficiency and efficacy of SIAR.

articleTitle: An Empirical Study of Operational Bias in Steering Tasks for Different User Groups
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Network and Information Systems for Computers (ICNISC)
abstract: In this paper, three different operational biases-A (accuracy emphasis), N (neutral) and F (speed emphasis) are investigated in the circular steering task for both younger and older user groups when interacting with computer interface. Experimental results show that operational biases have significant effect on human performance for both younger and older groups. The controllable range is wider for younger users than that for older users in terms of MT. User group only has significant effect on SD (Standard Deviation), but also significant effect on MT in bias-A condition. Older user group produces more SD than younger users do in all the three speed or accuracy emphasis. The fitness of a complement model of steering law for older user group is also verified in this paper. Finally, several implications for user interface design have been presented.

articleTitle: A Binaural Deep Neural Networks Parameter Mask for the Robust Automatic Speech Recognition System
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Network and Information Systems for Computers (ICNISC)
abstract: Within the framework of computational auditory scene analysis (CASA), a parameter masks estimator based on deep neural networks (DNN) is proposed for automatic speech recognition (ASR) in noisy environments. This paper addresses the robustness in binaural machine speech recognition by speech energy estimation using DNN. An ideal parameter mask (IPM) is introduced as the goal of the DNN estimator, which is calculated by the energy of the target speech and mixture. We systematically examine DNN generalization to untrained and real office configurations. Evaluations and comparisons show that the DNN based binaural estimator produces a superior signal to noise ratio (SNR) and ASR performance in a variety of noisy environments.

articleTitle: Flexible Design for Battery Management System
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Network and Information Systems for Computers (ICNISC)
abstract: By comparing difference battery management system (BMS), it comes to the conclusion that different BMS only has difference in communication data handle method and interface. To save the BMS design time, reduce the designer development workload, lead the BMS production satisfied market requirement quickly, this paper proposed flexible BMS design method. In the hardware design, this paper suggests module design method, the designer can finish a new BMS only by modify the interface module. In the software design, this paper proposes the hierarchical and embedded real-time operating system methods, the developer can achieve a new BMS by change the corresponding layered file separately. The flexible BMS design method mentioned in this paper can accelerates the process of the BMS design, shortens the production development cycle, and satisfies the market requirement speedily.

articleTitle: Optimization of High Voltage Direct Current Power Transmission System Based on Genetic Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Network and Information Systems for Computers (ICNISC)
abstract: High voltage direct current transmission system is for long-distance transmission of electricity. It consists of six functional subsystems. The redundancy and reliability of sub systems are optimized at the same time is an urgent engineering problem. This paper proposed an innovative method using genetic algorithm to optimize the assignment problem of redundancy and reliability of sub systems. The experimental results show that good outcome has been achieved.

articleTitle: A Soft Multi-core Architecture for THP of MIMO-OFDM Systems
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Network and Information Systems for Computers (ICNISC)
abstract: MIMO system is widely studied for its high performance in wireless communication, of which the THP algorithm is a bottleneck of performance. Generally the THP is implemented in ASIC for high performance, which unfortunately makes it a difficulty for system updating. Compared to the ASIC solution, configurable processing, as its inherent flexibility and extension, becomes a promising solution for this difficulty, especially in the case of FPGA based systems where multi-core method is utilized to make up for the performance deficiency of soft cores. This paper explores a micro blaze based-multi-core system to increase the performance of THP algorithm while keeping the system flexibility. In support of the flexibility to update the algorithm, the effective adaption of this approach is demonstrated. Moreover, optimized application specific hardware is combined with data-level paralleled software modules in the multi-core embedded system, which increases the performance of THP algorithm to a 6× speed over all-soft single-core solution.

articleTitle: File Dynamic Integrity in a Multi-user Environment
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Network and Information Systems for Computers (ICNISC)
abstract: In a Dynamic Verifiable Searchable Symmetric Encryption (DVSSE) scheme, a client Alice can perform keyword-based searches on ciphertexts, and update (modify, delete and add) documents in a verifiable way. However, the DVSSE scheme is not suitable for the multi-user environment, where Alice may authorize many users to update documents. The reason is that it is hard to achieve traceability based on the symmetric key. Furthermore, the DVSSE scheme cannot distinguish incomplete search results from incomplete document set. In this paper, we propose a Multi-user Dynamic Verifiable Searchable Encryption (MDVSE) scheme, which utilizes the Proxy Re-Encryption with keyword Search (PRES) to achieve multi-user envrionment, and applies the Merkle Hash Tree (MHT) to achieve integrity verification on both search results and document set. We analyze and conduct experiments to verify its feasibility.

articleTitle: A Document Image Retrieval Method Based on Multi-feature Fusion
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Network and Information Systems for Computers (ICNISC)
abstract: With the rising popularity of mobile devices, recent years have witnessed a growing interest in document image retrieval (DIR). In conventional Bag-of-Visual-Words (BoVW) based document image retrieval method, only SIFT or SURF feature is used to locate feature points and produce a codebook, which has a low discriminative power. Though several multiple feature based BoVW methods are proposed, these methods are based on multiple codebooks. However, some features can not train a codebook, such as connected-component feature. So this paper propose a new multi-feature fusion method, considering these features. Experimental results show that the proposed method has better performance.

articleTitle: Ground Vehicle Target Detection Algorithm Based on Saliency Detection
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Network and Information Systems for Computers (ICNISC)
abstract: An algorithm for ground vehicle target detection based on unsupervised learning and saliency detection is proposed. Firstly, acquire local features of vehicle target by unsupervised learning. Then code the detecting target image using these local features. Perform saliency detection in the image applying these features, and obtain the candidate target regions. The classifier applies only to those salient regions in order to ensure the efficiency of detection. Meanwhile, computation efficiency is guaranteed by simplifying highly relevant features.

articleTitle: Study on Application of Earthquake Catalog Formats Conversion System in the Analysis of Seismic Data
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Network and Information Systems for Computers (ICNISC)
abstract: To be used easily, an earthquake catalog format conversion algorithms has been developed in order to get over the shortcomings of the earthquake catalog. The earthquake directory structure, a data structure, which is based on C# language, is designed based on the object-oriented programming(OOP). The data are stored by text file so as to be viewed and modified easily. Earthquake catalog format not only meets the accuracy requirements, but also plays a very important role in the application of focal mechanism solution.

articleTitle: General Medical Information Management System Design Based on Cloud Computing
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Network and Information Systems for Computers (ICNISC)
abstract: By applying the community health care into the management of chronic disease, to realize the transformation from the traditional passive health management mode to the active mode. Import and introduce the concept and characteristics of cloud computing based on analyzing the existing problems of the current medical information system, then put forward the overall architecture of the general medical information management system based on cloud computing. From the cloud computing layer, service provider layer and user access layer three aspects, respectively design the structure and realize the functions for the system, and also introduce the key technologies used in the process, such as Hadoop framework, MVC, data visualization, and chart controls. Display the effect of general medical information management system in the form of B/S structure. Finally summarize the advantages of cloud computing on medical information management, and looked forward the prospect of the medical data mining.

articleTitle: Inverse P-Information Law Models and the Reality-Camouflage Intelligent Transformations of Information Image
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Network and Information Systems for Computers (ICNISC)
abstract: By improving function inverse P-sets, inverse P-information law model and its structures are proposed. Then attribute disjunctive expansion-contraction generations of inverse P-information law models are presented. Furthermore, inverse P-information reasoning and reasoning structures are proposed Finally intelligent generating theorems of information law are proposed, the reality-camouflage intelligent transformations of information image and their intelligent generations and applications are also given.

articleTitle: Serried Forwarder Routing (SFR): A Query-Driven Routing Algorithm for a Wireless Sensor Network with High Density of Nodes
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Network and Information Systems for Computers (ICNISC)
abstract: In a wireless sensor network with high density of nodes, for finding short routes to the sensor nodes satisfying the route request query committed by any sensor node while keeping the route discovery traffic to a low level, a query-driven routing algorithm called Serried Forwarder Routing (SFR) is proposed. SFR introduces a kind of quasi-unicasting mechanism for reducing the unnecessary route discovery traffic, and in virtue of the historical route searching results stored in the path table of each sensor node, SFR can find relatively short paths to the nodes satisfying the route request. Experiments show that in a wireless sensor network with high density of nodes, SFR greatly reduces the unnecessary route discovery traffic in comparison with flooding-based routing algorithms.

articleTitle: A Smart Document Review System for Business Expansion Project in Electric Power Marketing
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Network and Information Systems for Computers (ICNISC)
abstract: In response to the call of paperless meeting put forward by the national grid and reduce the waste of resources requirements, this paper introduces an intelligent review terminal for power marketing business expansion project, by studying the Cutting-edge technologies such as keyword retrieval, semantic analysis, the customizable and automatable knowledge base and intelligent analysis. At the beginning of review link of business expansion project, the functions implemented for customers to do like self-help pre-qualification online, the query of current standards, auxiliary intelligent review, Bluetooth print, experts login management, experts assessment management, it can assist power enterprise marketing in completing the file review of business expansion project by standard, normalized and intelligent operations, it also proposes a new technology of documents review for the departments of electric power industry.

articleTitle: Preliminary Study on Safety Technology of Digital Archives
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Network and Information Systems for Computers (ICNISC)
abstract: With the rapid development of Internet technology, related departments such as the party and government offices, enterprise organizations and national defenses will deal with a large number of digital archive information, some important data classified need transmit through the network. Study how to ensure the safety of the archives preservation and transmission is a matter of individual, collective and even the national development and security event. In order to improve the digital archives security, digital watermarking technology is introduced to the digital archives management process, can effectively enhance the protective function of the digital archives is the future development direction of the digital archives information security protection.

articleTitle: Conditional Edge Fault-Tolerant Hamiltonian-Connected of Locally Twisted Cubes LTQn
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Network and Information Systems for Computers (ICNISC)
abstract: The n-dimensional locally twisted cube LTQn is a variant of the hypercube, which possesses some properties superior to the hypercube. This paper investigates the conditional edge fault-tolerant Hamiltonian-connected of LTQn, and shows that for any n-dimensional locally twisted cube LTQn (n≥5) with faulty edges up to 2n-8 in which each vertex is incident to at least three fault-free edges, there exists a fault-free Hamiltonian path connecting any two vertices.

articleTitle: An Electricity Services Investigation Operating and Evaluation System Based on Hand-Held Terminal
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Network and Information Systems for Computers (ICNISC)
abstract: Using technology such as LBS, multimedia, mobile work flow to develop an electricity services investigation operating and evaluation system based on hand-held terminal. The system realizes functions such as the tasks inspection, work flow automatic generating, technical management standards retrieval query, business network locating and automatic matching profiles, site devices recognizing, data real-time interactive processing and automatic analyzing, sort management and retrieval query on work order case and on-site inspection evidentiary material, job card automatic generating, intelligent evaluation of inspection result and so on. The system promotes the quality investigation service of the state grid jibei electric power company, and raises the standards of quality service for investigations work standardization degree and operability.

articleTitle: TRPM: A Model of Rumor Propagation Based on Trust
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Network and Information Systems for Computers (ICNISC)
abstract: Based on the related theory of trust, this paper proposes the TRPM for the spread of rumor. Starting from the individual nodes of the network, the model on the basis of the network information dissemination, studies the game behavior of rumors in social networks between propagators and audiences. At the same time, through the SEIR model with the combination of the trust mechanism, we show the revenue function of TRPM. Then, we compare the results of TRPM and the results of the network information dissemination model by applying simulation tools. We conclude that the trust mechanism can more truly reflect the law of the spread of rumors. Therefore, by introducing trust into propagation model, we can vividly describe the complexity of social network, and get more effective monitoring of rumors.

articleTitle: Automatic Chain Cold Drawing Machine Design
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Network and Information Systems for Computers (ICNISC)
abstract: Introduced a system of automatic chain drawbench, Achieve a diameter Φ12 to Φ102 feeding tube drawing, the drawing system, blanking the full automation of the entire process. Elaborated on the overall design of the system of automatic chain drawbench, Includes functionality to the core of the PLC and inverter control system architecture, hardware and software components, and its implementation. The system has been promoted in the relevant enterprises to use, saving labor and equipment to improve the efficiency of the yield of steel, and achieved good results.

articleTitle: Research on Reliable Multicast in EBSN
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Network and Information Systems for Computers (ICNISC)
abstract: By saving network traffic and improving application throughput, Multicast becomes a pervasive traffic pattern in data centers. Reliable transmission is an important requirement in Modular Data Center. In this paper, we proposed a reliable multicast approach for EBSN, a modular data center structure. For efficient transmission, multiple multicast trees were constructed. To realize reliable, we chose multicast tree recovery according to the property of the EBSN. By this way, we acquired a reliable multicast.

articleTitle: ARP Enhancement to Stateful Protocol by Registering ARP Request
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Network and Information Systems for Computers (ICNISC)
abstract: Networking has become an essential factor in daily life and activities where the major problem in network security is the safety of the transfer information. The infrastructure for the networking is the TCP/IP suite, and the address resolution protocol is the core part of the standard which maps the logical address into a physical address. Address resolution protocol is defined as a stateless protocol in the network standard. Cache poisoning attacks target the address resolution protocol mapping to redirect the network traffic to the attacker machine, while the spoofing attack is an initialization phase for other attacks such as man-in-the-middle and denial of service attacks. The proposal in this paper is to defeat cache poisoning attacks by discarding the unregister reply, in other words, to enhance the address resolution protocol to become a stateful protocol and send a request based on the number of fake attacker replies received. The suggested address resolution protocol enhancement is examined and implemented in Linux kernel.

articleTitle: Design of Monitoring Software of Take-Off and Landing for UAV
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Network and Information Systems for Computers (ICNISC)
abstract: According as the composing and working theory of the taxing UAV, aim at the controlling for the takeoff and landing, the monitor software for the takeoff and landing is proposed. This software is based on Microsoft Visual C++6.0 and the virtual instrument. The software can real-time display flight attitude, track, parameters and the tracking divation. It showed the feasibility and necessarily of the softswar for the monitor and control system for the takeoff and landing for taxiing UAV.

Author Keywords: the Monitor and Control System for the takeoff and landing

articleTitle: An Opportunistic Routing with Minimizing the Expected Coordination Delay
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Network and Information Systems for Computers (ICNISC)
abstract: In order to minimize the candidate waiting time (coordination delay) caused by the opportunistic forward mechanism which is timer-based coordination, in this paper we put forward the optimal opportunistic routing whose coordination delay is tiny via a novel concept which is expected coordination delay. According to the mechanism of timer-based coordination, a mathematical model named expected coordination delay (ECD) is proposed to evaluate the candidate waiting time what a node forwards a packet to the destination will spend. And an opportunistic routing (OR) based on ECD is designed. The proposed routing compared to the classic OR, to a certain extent, can make up the defect that the coordination delay is too long in a dense network. The simulation result show that the ECD in our routing is close to the actual coordination delay, and the proposed routing has a lower coordination delay than the classic OR, simultaneously.

articleTitle: Research on Indoor Positioning Accuracy Based on Wi-Fi Intensity Values
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Network and Information Systems for Computers (ICNISC)
abstract: The purpose of this paper is to analyze theoretical distance resolution of signal intensity values from routers, and to give the accuracy of indoor positioning based on Wi Fi under the condition of fingerprint algorithm. This paper firstly carried out single point experiment (Experiment 1) and distance experiment (Experiment 2) to acquire theoretical distance resolution of signal intensity values from routers. Based on plenty of experimental data, this paper proposed "twice standard deviation data elimination algorithm" to eliminate gross error. Finally, carried on Experiment 3 to measure the accuracy of indoor positioning based on Wi Fi under the condition of fingerprint algorithm. Figure 4 and figure 5 shows the conclusion of theoretical distance resolution of signal intensity values from routers. The chapter of "CONCLUSION" summarizes all conclusions.

articleTitle: Modulation Performance Analysis of Terahertz Satellite Communications
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Network and Information Systems for Computers (ICNISC)
abstract: The amplitude and phase shift keying (APSK) modulation as a combination of PSK modulation and quadrature amplitude modulation(QAM) method, it can reduce the sensitivity of the nonlinear amplifier and improve the spectral efficiency, it has been widespread concern in satellite communications. Combined with 16PSK and 16QAM modulation performance, analyzed 16APSK modulation, verified the superiority 16APSK modulation terahertz satellite communications.

articleTitle: An Adaptive Statistical Neural Network Model
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Network and Information Systems for Computers (ICNISC)
abstract: Traditional back propagating algorithms of artificial neural network are supervised batch-learning algorithms. And they are faced with challenges from the huge number of real-time data in Internet. In this paper, we put forward an unsupervised incremental learning model. This is an adaptive statistical neural network model. It is built on the foundation of statistical theory rather than gradient descent search. Experiments on classical datasets demonstrate that the clustering algorithm of this model is comparable with traditional clustering algorithms such as K-means. Moreover, it can also execute supervised learning in theory.

articleTitle: Study of openGIS for Earthquake Analysis and Prediction System
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Network and Information Systems for Computers (ICNISC)
abstract: In order to fuse seismic information and spatial information together while reducing the investment cost of software for seismological departments, we introduced openGIS to the analysis and prediction of earthquake and create Map Manager module of Earthquake Analysis and Prediction System that supports the function of displaying seismic information on map and simple Spatial analysis and map editing function.

Author Keywords: openGIS DotSpatial Earthquake Analysis and Prediction System

articleTitle: An Adaptive PNC Strategy for Satellite Communication
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Network and Information Systems for Computers (ICNISC)
abstract: Trying to overcome the obstacles, such as low throughput and high SER or BER in traditional satellite systems, PNC was implied in the Satellite PNC System established in this paper with efficiency and reliability. The performances of AF-PNC, DF-PNC and DNF-PNC in the Satellite PNC System were investigated with simulations. With simulations results, an adaptive PNC strategy-Adaptive PNC was proposed according to the real channel situations. The simulation showed that Adaptive PNC proposed in this paper had the better channel adaptability and the lower BER than the single PNC method. Our work reveals that PNC are worthy of consideration in satellite applications.

articleTitle: Automated Assessment Method of Chinese Subjective Questions Based on Semantics
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Network and Information Systems for Computers (ICNISC)
abstract: Subjective question is an important question for checking the learning knowledge ability of the student, but the subjective question automated assessment suffers from many difficulties. Based on the analysis of automated assessment of Chinese subjective questions, in this paper we have proposed a novel automated assessment algorithm for subjective questions automated assessment using sentence similarity method. The results of the research indicate that this algorithm is promising.

articleTitle: Research of Materials Unique Identification System Framework for IoT
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Network and Information Systems for Computers (ICNISC)
abstract: The development of the Internet of things(IoT) put forward the requirement for the materials unique identification, in order to promote the interconnection between Internet of things systems, the visualization in the whole process of materials management and the sharing for Internet of things information. It establishes a materials identification system structural framework by materials identification code(MID), data identifying(DI), management system, query and analysis service, regulations and standards, etc. And analyze the operation mechanism of materials identification system.

articleTitle: Trust QoS Routing Scheme Based on Internal Matching in Mobile Peer-to-Peer Networks
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Network and Information Systems for Computers (ICNISC)
abstract: In Mobile Peer-to-Peer networks (MP2P), the network state information is difficult to measure accurately, and application requirement on quality of service (QoS) and trust is also hard to exactly express. Therefore, trust QoS routing scheme should be based on the fuzzy information. In this paper, we propose a trust QoS routing scheme based on interval matching. It applies the interval form to denote the network state information and application requirement respectively, then evaluates each link with interval matching strategy and takes the evaluation value as the weight of the corresponding link. The simple and effective method makes it be appropriate in MP2P. Finally a heuristic algorithm is proposed to generate a solution for given network applications. Results from simulation experiments demonstrate that our proposed routing scheme could get higher routing success ratio compared with others.

articleTitle: The Performance Analysis of Quantum Illumination Radar
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Network and Information Systems for Computers (ICNISC)
abstract: Quantum radar based on the mechanism of quantum physics and the quantum information is a new sensing technology that was developed to solve technology bottleneck of classic radar. Especially, The Quantum illumination based on entanglement light beam could overcome noise and information loss. In this paper, the principle of quantum radar is introduced in detail, and the quantum illumination radar scheme using entangled photons is discussed. Then, target detection method based on entangled photons is given, and simulation results are showed. Finally, it is demonstrated by experiments that the performance of entangled photon detection system is superior to non-entangled photon detection system in a noisy and lossy environment, and the targets appear to look bigger when looked with low photon number.

articleTitle: The Role of Big Data Analysis in New Product Development
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Network and Information Systems for Computers (ICNISC)
abstract: In recent years, the rapid development of Internet, Internet of Things, mobile application and Cloud Computing have led to the explosive growth of data in almost every business and industry area. Today, the big data technology and concepts have been gradually applied to the traditional industry from the Internet industry, big data has become an important driving force for economic reform and development. Market and consumer analytics is at the epicenter of a Big Data revolution. In this paper, we first briefly introduce the concept of big data, including its definition, features, and value. We then identify from different perspectives the significance and opportunities that big data brings to us. Next, we introduce the relationships among traditional marketing analysis (TMA), big data analysis (BDA), and new product development (NPD). We propose a big data analysis model to analyze the behavior of consumers in order to improve the competitiveness of new products. Finally, we conclude the paper by giving some suggestions on using big data analysis for NPD and some future research ideas.

articleTitle: A Novel Meta-Heuristic-Based Sequential Forward Feature Selection Approach for Anomaly Detection Systems
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Network and Information Systems for Computers (ICNISC)
abstract: Anomaly detection technique play an extraordinary role in the Intrusion Detection System (IDS) for its ability to detect novel attacks. To overcome the high-dimensionality problem the anomaly detection cursed of, we propose a novel Meta-Heuristic-based Sequential Forward Selection (MH_SFS) feature selection algorithm, which can be generally implemented in anomaly detection system. It is an improvement of the traditional Sequential Forward Selection (SFS) feature selection algorithm. After every iteration of SFS, we append a meta-heuristic search to tackle the "nesting effect" problem. And a filter-based function is added to counteract the computational cost from the additional metaheuristic search process. During the testing phase, based on KDD Cup 99 dataset, we compare our improved algorithm to the traditional SFS algorithm and the state-of-the-art IFFS algorithm over three anomaly detection models. The experimental results strongly show that our algorithm can yield higher detection performance and smaller number of features selected, while computations are in a permitted range.

articleTitle: A Two Time-Scales Network Bandwidth Measurement for Video Transmission
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Network and Information Systems for Computers (ICNISC)
abstract: In order to solve the contradiction between the reliability of video transmission and the network bandwidth fluctuations, a two time-scales network bandwidth measurement for video stream transmission is proposed. Firstly, a model-based long time-scale bandwidth trend extraction is proposed, which is used to calculate the current bandwidth through a Transmission Control Protocol (TCP) throughput model, and predict a trend of network bandwidth using an Exponential Smoothing Model (ESM) according to the calculated current bandwidth. Secondly, short time-scale bandwidth fluctuation detection is proposed to divide the network status into three categories, according to which additively increase or multiplicatively decrease the estimated bandwidth. The experimental results illustrate that our proposed algorithm can satisfy the requirements of TCP-friendliness and real-time for the video transmission.

articleTitle: Based on Bayesian Networks Improvement Semiconductors Quality the Key Technology Research
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Network and Information Systems for Computers (ICNISC)
abstract: Material quality throughout the whole process of semiconductor manufacturing, materials and Product qualified rate are directly related to the manufacturing costs and survival of the enterprise. Manufacturing Execution System can induce, arrange and discover product effective data, rules and basic measures automatically to identify this unqualified and stop the subsequent batch of work, effective prevention and intervention before in its early stage. A practical, probabilistic reasoning methodology for estimating MES for corrective actions implemented during a reliability growth test Phase. A fault-diagnosis model based on Bayesian networks can resolve uncertain decisions and competitive problems. So hence, basing on Leaky Noisy-OR model that delves into the failure-mode effect analysis (FMEA) and A fault-diagnosis model, trying to realize how to research mass fault diagnose data, establish effective algorithms and systematic programs to provide a reasoning rule that is used to statistical analysis of qualified rate of products and processes, statistical analysis of exception handling batches, product quality status, statistical analysis of abnormal responsibility, reason, phenomenon, statistical analysis of exception handling efficiency.

articleTitle: B-CaB: Optimizing the SP's Bidding for Cache and Band Resources in Virtualized Wireless Networks
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Network and Information Systems for Computers (ICNISC)
abstract: In recent years, network virtualization has been introduced to wireless networks due to its great success in wired networks as well as the rapid developing of wireless networks. Resource management is always a key issue in virtualized wireless networks. In this paper, under the resource auction architecture for resource management, we focus on the optimal bidding actions of the service providers (SPs). With the objective of maximizing the SP's total reward, which is composed of the user service reward and the resource utilizing costs, the optimal bidding behavior decision scheme with consideration of caching and spectrum utilization costs, which is called B-CaB, is proposed in this paper. The Markov decision process with unknown parameter (MDP-UP) model is adopted in our formulation, and then we reformulation it as a partially observable Markov decision process, to deal with the challenging problem that the state transition parameter is not always known or observable. Extensive simulation results are presented to demonstrate the significant performance improvement of the proposed scheme.

articleTitle: Research on the Early Warning Information Release Technology of Urban Explosion Based on Knowledge Model
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Network and Information Systems for Computers (ICNISC)
abstract: Urbans explosion disaster warning information release is an important part of emergency rescue and disposal operations. The author tries to make knowledge of human knowledge and skills to two types of tacit knowledge to the greatest extent of excavated into useful patterns or explicit knowledgethrough the knowledge model, These mining patterns or knowledge must be useful, has potential value, and can be understood. Establish and improve the town explosion disaster warning information release technology in order to better serve the community, andto protect the healthy development of society.

articleTitle: Knowledge Modeling Based on Ontology for Disaster Warning Information Release Technology of Urban Industrial Disaster
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Network and Information Systems for Computers (ICNISC)
abstract: The author uses the concept about human disaster early warning which was defined by the United Nations International Disaster Reduction Strategy (ISDR), according to the present situation of urban industrial disaster early warning information released, the author uses the method of knowledge acquisition to obtain the relationship between the main concepts and concepts of the urban industrial disaster warning information release technology events. The authors use ontology modeling tool protégé to establish knowledge model of urban industrial disaster warning information publishing technology based on ontology, and studied the knowledge model. Research results show: the knowledge model is built to describe the semantic relations between knowledge points, conceptual relations are closely related, support for reasoning on semantic logic, strong expansibility.
